# Apokaliptium

> Apokaliptium is an open platform for a shared future: open knowledge,
> technology and people, with a Type III civilization as the far horizon.
> The site is a single Polish-language page told in seven scenes.

The page is maintained by Sett Sarverott. Illustrations are concept art.

## Scenes

- [01 Wspólny horyzont](https://www.apokaliptium.online/#opening): the shared horizon.
- [02 Inceptorium Apokryf](https://www.apokaliptium.online/#apokryf): open science and technology; research, education, prototypes, documentation.
- [03 Sieć możliwości](https://www.apokaliptium.online/#network): a decentralized network of open protocols, knowledge continuity, resources and logistics.
- [04 RedScope Technologies](https://www.apokaliptium.online/#redscope): engineering, production and commercialization.
- [05 Radio Kocia Muzyka](https://www.apokaliptium.online/#radio): media, culture and knowledge for everyone.
- [06 Różne umysły](https://www.apokaliptium.online/#choir): people and artificial intellects working together.
- [07 Droga do typu III](https://www.apokaliptium.online/#future): the path from small steps to galactic scale.
